mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth signals robust economic fundamentals, compressing equity risk premiums and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2% YoY.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when GDPC1 growth >2% YoY over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% signals labor market weakness, triggering immediate equity sell-offs as recession fears rise within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >50% of instances when UNRATE >4.5 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous FEDFUNDS >5.25% and CPIAUCSL >202.5 signals aggressive monetary tightening amid persistent inflation, causing sustained equity declines over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >40% of instances when FEDFUNDS >5.25 and CPIAUCSL >202.5 over any 3-year rolling window.
